correctness.rationale: Every possible gradient simplex is exhaustively enumerated. A fixed 831-pair face-poset matching is verified against all 6606 Hasse covers; topological sorting of the reversed-cover digraph reaches all 1727 faces, proving acyclicity. The critical set is exactly one 0-cell and 64 4-cells, so Forman reduction gives a wedge of 64 four-spheres. Independent mod-2 boundary ranks give reduced Betti vector (0,0,0,0,64).
risks: The proof depends on the implementation matching the stated definition; this is mitigated by exhaustive enumeration, full Hasse-graph acyclicity verification, and an independent boundary-rank computation.

value.rationale: The triangular prism is a canonical small connected cubic graph. The exact sphere-wedge type is a natural benchmark that strictly strengthens both general connectivity bounds and the closest same-object homology-only computation, while remaining a self-contained exact fact rather than a routine normalization check.
risks: The result is a single-graph classification rather than a family theorem; its value is as a canonical exact benchmark and as a strict upgrade from homology/connectivity information.
